benchmark_identity.claim_boundary: The archive predates explicit BENCHMARK_ARCHIVE_FIELDS metadata. Step 0A is therefore a reviewed legacy inference, not an identity claimed to have been recorded explicitly by the run.
inference_basis: The source-identified driver revision implements closed Step 0 Case A for this generalized-alpha path.
The retained load histories contain the canonical active-tension cycle and identically zero cavity pressure.

bounded_claim: This report compares one completed, source-identified CoupFE-Cardiac run with the separately distributed benchmark time curves on a common grid. It is example-level evidence, not clinical, device, or broad solver validation. It does not by itself establish mesh/time convergence, equivalence to the reference P2 discretization, or a unique twist direction. A closed-topology statement, when present, is bounded to the retained pre-solve geometry and boundary audits.

selection.policy: Select the exact 10 Case A/Case B team files explicitly loaded by upstream results_time_curves/figures.py. Reject missing selected files and unexpected matching files. Accept the unselected base-name SimVascular file only when byte-identical to selected SimVascular P2, then exclude it as a duplicate alias.
